name: image_generation
description: Generate an image from a text prompt (Flux model via Pollinations.ai) and upload it for download/viewing. No API key required for basic use, no card, no signup — genuinely free. Set POLLINATIONS_API_KEY (a free sk_ key from enter.pollinations.ai) to remove the shared per-IP rate limit if this gets used a lot.

prompt.description: Description of the image to generate.

filename.description: Optional filename (with .jpg/.png extension). Auto-generated from the prompt if omitted.

seed.description: Optional seed for reproducible output — same prompt + same seed = same image.

model.description: Which image model to use. Default 'flux'. 'turbo' is faster/lower-quality, 'kontext' supports image-editing-style prompts.
